groups.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing
groups.description: W3C trace propagation and OTLP settings.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.enabled
properties.description: Whether platform security defaults are eligible to activate.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.issuer
properties.description: Absolute HTTP(S) issuer used by the default JWT decoder.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.public-endpoints
properties.description: Permit-only application path patterns.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.public-actuator-endpoints
properties.description: Whether present and exposed health/info actuator endpoints are public.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.role-claims-path
properties.description: Optional dot-separated nested JWT claim path used for role extraction.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.security.role-prefix
properties.description: Prefix applied to extracted role authorities; an empty prefix is valid.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Whether platform tracing and correlation integration are eligible to activate.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.sampling-probability
properties.description: Inclusive probability used for recording/export sampling.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.otlp.endpoint
properties.description: Absolute exporter endpoint, or null to keep export disabled.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.otlp.protocol
properties.description: OTLP transport protocol.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.otlp.headers
properties.description: Export headers; values are secrets and must never be logged.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.otlp.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allotted to one exporter operation.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.tracing.otlp.compression
properties.description: OTLP payload compression.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether platform metrics policy is eligible to activate.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.metrics.common-tags
properties.description: Bounded, non-sensitive common tags applied by the platform policy.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.errors.enabled
properties.description: Whether platform error handlers are eligible to activate.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.errors.detail-policy
properties.description: Detail disclosure policy; GENERIC is the safe default.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.errors.include-instance
properties.description: Whether a safe request path is included as ProblemDetail.instance.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.enabled
properties.description: Whether the platform logging contribution is eligible to activate.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.console-enabled
properties.description: Whether the default structured console sink is enabled.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.otel-enabled
properties.description: Whether sanitized events are forwarded to an available OTel log pipeline.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.redaction-mask
properties.description: Replacement value used by the baseline and configured redaction rules.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.additional-sensitive-fields
properties.description: Additional case-insensitive exact fields, headers, or query parameter names.

properties.name: logistics.parent-service.logging.additional-sensitive-paths
properties.description: Additional dot-separated structured paths to redact.
